text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and latency observed in us-west-2 impacting Hosted API + Dedicated GPU pools. 5xx-rate 8.6% (5m). Source: apigw-frontend / auth-proxy traces. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/incident/usw2-apigw

Olivia (sre-oncall): ack, paging SRE. assigning incident lead, grabbing traces & runbook. tagging eng-runtime.

Jamal (eng-runtime): I see a spike of upstream 502/504 from apigw -> auth-proxy. STS and iam calls showing increased RTT and timeouts. beginning deeper trace. suspected third-party auth/API throttling in us-west-2.

Leo (network-eng): Confirmed increased connection latency to iam.amazonaws.com and apigateway.amazonaws.com endpoints in us-west-2 from our egress nodes. Also seeing delayed CloudWatch logs ingestion. Looks regional.

Maria (support): Customer impact: Support queue has 5 tickets referencing 5xx in the last 20m; 2 of them are dedicated customers pinned to us-west-2 pools (high priority). CS notified provisional incident page.

Olivia (sre-oncall): Quick mitigation plan (priority order):
1) activate region-fallback routing for new requests from us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 (gradual shift).
2) scale up dedicated capacity in eu-west-1 and bind affected customers there as fallback.
3) apply temporary rate-limits for anonymous/low-tier keys in us-west-2 to preserve capacity for paid customers.
4) switch hosted default model in us-west-2 to a smaller model variant to reduce token latency (non-breaking).
5) notify customers and ops channels.

Jamal (eng-runtime): Running commands now.
```
# enable region fallback (gradual)
redwoodctl routing set-policy --region us-west-2 --fallback eu-west-1 --mode gradual --pct 30
# scale dedicated fallback pool
redwoodctl dedicated scale --pool eu-west-1-fallback --replicas 4
# apply temporary rate limit for anon keys in us-west-2
redwoodctl quotas update --region us-west-2 --key-type anon --qps 50
```

Olivia (sre-oncall): executing step1/3. will post updates.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3892. Pager duty: olivia -> jamal. Priority: P1.

Jamal (eng-runtime): Step1 done. started shifting ~30% of new requests out of us-west-2 into eu-west-1 via fallback policy. Observing immediate drop in 5xx-rate to ~4.1% (5m).

Leo (network-eng): AWS status shows a partial disruption for API Gateway & STS in us-west-2: https://status.aws.amazon.com/incident/12345. Opening AWS case #987654321.

Tom (solutions): Looping in account reps for the two dedicated customers so they have visibility. Drafting short customer advisory.

Maria (support): Posting advisory in status.redwood.ai (incidents page) and sending targeted emails to affected dedicated customers.

Jamal (eng-runtime): Additional logs for triage:
```
2026-03-17T12:34:21Z ERROR 502 upstream_timeout apigw->auth-proxy trace_id=xyz123 svc=apigw-frontend
2026-03-17T12:34:23Z WARN 504 sts_timeout iam.amazonaws.com call_id=abc789
```

Olivia (sre-oncall): Monitoring metrics: looking for sustained drop <1% 5xx for 15m before rolling back fallbacks and limits. If AWS provides ETA we'll update.

Jamal (eng-runtime): As a precaution, enabling smaller model default in us-west-2 to reduce per-token latency. Will revert when stable.

Leo (network-eng): Added eBPF traces on egress nodes to ensure no local network blackholes. Nothing obvious so far beyond increased RTT to AWS control-plane endpoints.

ops-bot: Pager update: INC-2026-3892 status -> "mitigating".

Olivia (sre-oncall): Current status: fallback routing active (~35% traffic shifted), dedicated fallback scaled, rate limits applied. 5xx-rate trending down (now 3.8%). Customer impact reduced but not fully resolved. Continuing watch. Handing off to Jamal for overnight monitoring in 45m. Postmortem required. :white_check_mark:

Jamal (eng-runtime): I'll take over monitoring and coordinate with AWS support case. Leaving this thread as primary live-mitigation channel.

Tom (solutions): Logged communications to affected customers + internal notes.

Maria (support): Support queue cleans up as errors drop. keeping CS notified.

Olivia (sre-oncall): Thanks team. If things worsen, escalate to exec oncall and prepare rollback plan. Otherwise maintain mitigations and collect logs/traces for postmortem. :phone:

incident-bot: Next reminder in 15m. Update this thread with major changes or when mitigation conditions met.
